combined.note: the rate is over the GENERATION pools only.  A reconstruction pool inherits the real chemistry it started from, so pooling it with a generation pool would produce a rate that is neither a generator number nor a decoder number; its own numbers live in combined_by_kind.reconstruction (scope: decoder_fidelity_on_real_geometries).  Pool kind: molmetal/scripts/cfm_pool_kind.py.  COHORT SCALE: the denominator MIXES cohort scales -- it is a mixed-cohort rate (scale_label=mixed_cohort_scale): n_train=26715 (full_corpus, 1 pool): 0 SA<=4.5 hits in 66 molecules; n_train=256 (small, 2 pools): 16 SA<=4.5 hits in 2330 molecules -- so this rate is NOT the full-corpus generator's rate; the full-corpus-only rate is in combined_by_tier.full_corpus (combined_by_tier holds the GENERATION pools only; rule: full_corpus if n_train >= 26715; small if n_train < 1024; else mid; unknown if n_train is None)
